outlook.statement: Global real GDP growth is projected to moderate to around 3.0%, constrained by rising trade frictions, persistent geopolitical and policy uncertainties, elevated market volatility, and divergent inflationary trends across major economies.

India's economic journey over recent years has been characterized by remarkable resilience, structural transformation, and a steady ascent on the global stage. Having previously overtaken the United Kingdom to claim the fifth-largest economy spot, India advanced further to surpass Japan, solidifying its position as the fourth-largest economy in the world.

Real estate sector in India is expected to reach US$ 1 trillion in market size by 2030, up from US$ 200 billion in 2021 and contribute 13% to the country's GDP by 2026. The Indian real estate market is projected to experience a substantial increase, potentially reaching a value of US$ 5-7 trillion by the year 2047, with the possibility of surpassing US$ 10 trillion.
